nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Pop Sungloss Shades for Lips SPF 50

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensory sensitivities and one prone to allergic reactions from lip sunscreen both report this product was well tolerated, with no taste aversion or allergic reaction.

aspects.libelle: Functions as liquid lipstick not gloss
Bleeds into fine lines and skin around lips
Transfers onto teeth, chin, or clothing
Received with near or past expiration date
Feels drying on lips after application

extraits.titre: I agree, it's like a liquid lipstick NOT a gloss
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately, it didn't work out for me. First, the positives: it has spf 50 and it uses mineral sunscreen filters. It is extremely hard to find lip products with these 2 properties! I also LOVE the color and how highly pigmented it is. I'm so bored with the typical sheer mauvy shades that most brands are putting out there, especially in the category of lip balms/lip spfs/gloss. So, it will definitely be hard to find a replacement for this product. The negatives and why it didn't work out for me: I agree with the reviewer who said that it feels like a liquid lipstick rather than a gloss. It is EXTREMELY drying, like your lips feel dry immediately upon application. It also settles into all the fine lines you didn't even know you had on your lips. This is not at all what I was looking for as it's marketed as being a lip gloss! In addition, it tends to "bleed" into my chin and transfer intensely on my teeth, which is an extra hassle I need to deal with with this product. The only way I could sort of make it work is by first applying a lip balm/chapstick, next applying this product, then blotting it, then applying a layer of lip oil or lip gloss (an actual gloss!) on top of it. To me this defeats the purpose of this product, as I was really looking for a 3-in-1 product (SPF/color/lip conditioning). I feel like I might as well just get a plain mineral lip spf (sunbum for example) for a fraction of the price, which would require a similar

extraits.titre: Thick and pigmented like lipstick, not a gloss
extraits.texte: 2 things: 1) This was WAY too pigmented for me. Not a gloss so much as its a liquid lipstick. You would definitely need a lip liner to prevent bleeding and it would transfer. 2) I realized unfortunately after trying the product that I was sent a product with an expiration date of next month… I will be returning.

From the tube, this looks like it would be a gorgeous color. Unfortunately they sent me an expired one. I had to use the magnifying app on my cell phone to see the EXP, since its stamped in black on a black box. But it clearly reads EXP 2025/08. I'll be returning it. Glad I checked before thinking my lips were protected.

I am autistic with sensory issues and this is the ONLY lip SPF that doesn't have that nasty stay in your mouth forever taste. Not only that, but the colour is beautifully rich and glides on brilliantly. I had no doubt this would be a good purchase because this white girl knows that Black women know where it's at. Black Girl Sunscreen thought of EVERYTHING. 100% should be a staple in every purse.

extraits.titre: Please come out with more shades!
extraits.texte: Very impressed with this lipstick. I got shade Red Wine and its super pigmented. After awhile, it leaves more of a stain than a gloss but it does last long compared to regular lip glosses. I would love if they can come out with nude shades so I can wear this often. No sunscreen taste/feel and not too thick when its applied. Received lots of compliments on the color. I'm more on the neutral tan side. Love that it has SPF 50, when other products only have at most SPF 35. Given that its a red shade, please note that it does bleed (gets into the small lines) so application has to be precise. When the lip gloss is in the process of drying, the gloss tends to transfer (can easily matte it down with transculent powder).
Sometimes I get an allergic reaction to sunscreen for the lips, but not this one. It doesn't taste nasty either, and goes on like a lipstick—heavily pigmented in a good way. I would buy again.

reserve: Reviews focus almost entirely on color, texture and application rather than skin type or skin concerns, so segmentation by skin type or concern is largely unsupported by this data.
